input.plan:
# Fix the shared marketing footer The screenshot on `/engineering` is the same Footer used on every marketing page. Two layout bugs stack: 1. **Sparse columns** — [`homepage/components/Footer.tsx`](homepage/components/Footer.tsx) stacks brand above `sm:grid-cols-3`. The three link groups stay left-aligned inside equal tracks, so desktop shows a large empty right half. 2. **Floating footer on inner pages** — pricing, MCP, how-it-works, country `[slug]`, and engineering wrap Header + main + Footer in `min-h-screen` → `max-w-site px-4 pb-8`. `min-h-screen` is on the outer box, which is not a flex column, so the footer sits after short content with white space below. Footer also applies `landing-shell` (max-width 67.5rem + padding) *inside* that wrapper, so the rule and content are double-inset. The homepage already places `
` as a sibling of `
` and does not have this second bug. ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph today [Inner pages today] Outer["min-h-screen"] Inner["max-w-site px-4 pb-8"] Outer --> Inner Inner --> Header Inner --> Main Inner --> NestedFooter["Footer + landing-shell"] end subgraph proposed [Proposed chrome] Shell["min-h-dvh flex flex-col"] Nav["landing-nav-shell + Header"] Grow["flex-1 children"] Foot["Footer full-bleed"] Shell --> Nav Shell --> Grow Shell --> Foot end ``` ## 1. Footer content layout In [`homepage/components/Footer.tsx`](homepage/components/Footer.tsx) and the matching rules in [`homepage/app/globals.css`](homepage/app/globals.css) (`.landing-footer`, `.footer-brand`): - Desktop (`md+`): one row — brand + tagline on the left, Product / Countries / Project filling the remaining width (`minmax(0, 1.2fr)` + three `minmax(0, 0.7fr)` tracks, or equivalent flex). - Mobile: keep stacked brand then link groups; no two-line link labels; no horizontal scroll. - Keep the existing link lists and copy. Do not invent extra footer chrome. ## 2. Site chrome so every page inherits the fix Lift Header and Footer out of per-page wrappers into [`homepage/app/layout.tsx`](homepage/app/layout.tsx): ```tsx
{children}
``` Then strip duplicated chrome from: - [`homepage/app/page.tsx`](homepage/app/page.tsx) - [`homepage/app/pricing/page.tsx`](homepage/app/pricing/page.tsx) - [`homepage/app/mcp/page.tsx`](homepage/app/mcp/page.tsx) - [`homepage/app/how-it-works/page.tsx`](homepage/app/how-it-works/page.tsx) - [`homepage/app/[slug]/page.tsx`](homepage/app/[slug]/page.tsx) - [`homepage/components/engineering/EngineeringShell.tsx`](homepage/components/engineering/EngineeringShell.tsx) Inner pages keep their own `main` (still `max-w-2xl` / `max-w-4xl` as today). After this, `EngineeringShell` only wraps children — delete it and inline on the two engineering pages rather than leave an empty shell. ## 3. Verify, then export - Browser: homepage, a short inner page (`/engineering`, `/pricing`), a long inner page (`/mcp` or a country page), desktop and ~375px. Footer must sit on the viewport bottom when content is short, columns must fill the content width on desktop, and the top rule must be full-bleed like the homepage. - Rebuild Flask static export with `npm run build:flask` in `homepage/` so [`relocation_jobs/static/homepage/`](relocation_jobs/static/homepage/) matches source. No Python/domain changes. Do not commit unless asked.
